About Bangladesh Overview

MBBS in Bangladesh

MBBS in Bangladesh offers quality education at reasonable fees with well-structured courses and modern facilities. The country’s safe atmosphere, warm people, and cultural similarity attract many Indian students, making it a top choice for medical study.

The affordability factor is the most attractive feature of studying MBBS in Bangladesh. The cost of MBBS in Bangladesh is very affordable compared to many Western countries or even other parts of Asia, hence making it an ideal destination for students from countries like India, Nepal, and Sri Lanka.

Additionally, the MBBS program in Bangladesh is approved by international medical councils such as WHO and MCI, and thus, the education the students get is competitive at the global level. Top medical colleges in Bangladesh have been properly equipped with modern facilities, providing students with an appropriate course relevant for producing skillful and efficient health professionals.

Why Study MBBS in Bangladesh?

Affordability without compromising on quality assurance

Comprehensive coursing with theoretical and clinical exposure is provided by the schools of medicine in Bangladesh, with an assurance that the students are competent enough to accomplish their jobs as futurologists.

01

Affordable Education: MBBS in Bangladesh fees is lower compared to many other nations. The overall expense of education including tuition and accommodation comes around INR 25 lakhs to INR 40 lakhs for the total duration of the MBBS course.

02

Globally Recognized Degrees: The World Health Organization and Medical Council of India accreditations are present in most medical schools, meaning graduates have achieved international standards.

03

English-Medium Instruction: The entire course is provided in English. All courses, lectures, examinations, and textbooks are available in the English language, meaning no student faces any kind of language barrier.

04

Cultural Similarities & Safety: Food, language, and ways of living are almost the same as those in eastern parts of India. Bangladesh is a comparatively safe country for international students, with universities offering counseling and assistance.

All Requirements for MBBS in Bangladesh

Understand the essential criteria and requirements

Ensure your eligibility for pursuing MBBS and starting your medical journey.

Eligibility Criteria to Apply

To secure MBBS admission in Bangladesh, students must meet the following criteria:

  • Applicant must be at least 17 years of age.
  • Must have passed 12th with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (min 60% aggregate in PCB).
  • At least 70% in the Biology subject is mandatory.
  • There should be no more than a One-year gap after 10+2.
  • A GPA score of less than 3.50 points in any single exam will not be considered (10th & 12th).
  • NEET should be qualify.

Required Documents & Intake

The application window for MBBS programs generally opens in November or December of the preceding year. Most medical colleges start their academic session in January or February.

Documents Needed:

  • 10th & 12th Mark sheet & Passing Certificate.
  • Passport, Aadhaar copy & NEET result.
  • PCC (Police Clearance Certificate) FOR J & K Students.
  • Bank Statement & Sponsorship Affidavit.
  • 10 White Background Photographs with 70% Face (Size 3.5 X 4.5 CM).
Indian Students

Why Indian Students Choose Bangladesh?

MBBS in Bangladesh for Indian students has gained immense popularity within the last few years due to its affordability, quality education, and cultural similarities.

MBBS in Bangladesh for Indian Students

Costs a fraction of what is sold at private medical colleges in India; with quality education, this factor essentially makes Bangladesh an ideal choice for doctor aspirants coming out of the financial load.

Affordable MBBS Programs The MBBS programs in Bangladesh cost around INR 25 lakhs to INR 35 lakhs for the entire course, keeping in mind the tuition and living costs.
No Extra Entrance Exams Most medical colleges in Bangladesh do not require an entrance test like NEET or any other admission test. The main requirement is a very good academic record in PCB at 12th-grade level.
Cultural Similarities & Proximity Food, language, and ways of living are almost the same. Bangladesh is quite near to India, which provides ease in traveling back home.
Recognition & Opportunities Degrees are verified by the Medical Council of India (MCI Act 1956). Students are eligible to practice medicine in India after clearing the FMGE/NExT exam.

Advantages of MBBS in Bangladesh

Bangladesh is a member of the South East Asia Regional Organization for the Medical Council; therefore, it has standards of training in medical education accepted globally.

MCI Approved Medical Study

The degree provided from the recognized medical colleges is approved by the Medical Council of India as it has its endorsement based upon the MCI Act, 1956.

Regulated by BMDC

All medical schools in Bangladesh are regulated and accredited by BMDC, providing eligibility for registration to practice medicine.

Screening Test Readiness

Graduates appearing for a screening examination at FMGE or NEXT validate the foreign institutions, allowing them to practice in Indian territory.

Sufficient Patient Stream

The clinical environment has a proper flow of admitted patients so that the students are adequately related to different disciplines during clinical rotations.

Global Communication

English instruction helps interact with medical communities across the globe with much ease and allows access to medical literature.

Career Enhancement

Most countries also recognize the medical degrees of Bangladesh, and thus USA, UK, and Canada are a few countries where students can go for further studies.

Campus Life & Living Expenses

Low Living Cost Requires about INR 8,000 to INR 12,000 per month.

Campus life in Bangladesh is comfortable and friendly for Indian students. Medical colleges offer modern classrooms, equipped labs, libraries and safe hostels. Indian food is easily available and cultural similarity helps students adjust quickly.

In Bangladesh, the cost of living is not too high, so students may require about INR 8,000 to INR 12,000 per month to cover their expenses in terms of accommodation, food, transport, and personal needs. Extra charges will be required for books and medical equipment, fetching a-month expense of approximately INR 15,000-INR 20,000.

Pathway Particulars

Duration & Structure

The duration of MBBS in Bangladesh is typically 5 years, followed by a mandatory 1-year internship. It includes a Pre-Clinical Phase (2 Years) for basic sciences, a Para-Clinical Phase (1 Year) for pathology and pharmacology, and a Clinical Phase (2 Years) for practical training in hospitals.

Medium of Teaching

English is the primary language of instruction for all MBBS courses in Bangladesh. All the courses, lectures, examinations, and textbooks are available in the English language.

MBBS Admission In Bangladesh

A step-by-step roadmap to admission

The application window for MBBS programs generally opens in November or December of the preceding year.

  1. Fill out the application form: Fill out the admission form from the RMC website.
  2. Select your University: Select your NMC-approved desired university to study MBBS.
  3. Submit Documents: Submit scanned documents: 10th and 12th mark sheets, NEET score card, copy of the medical certificate, and passport.
  4. Receive Invitation: After 10-15 days of applying and submitting the application form, you'll get the invitation letter from the university.
  5. Apply for Visa: Students can apply for a visa in the respective embassy for 10 days of visa processing. Apply 2-3 months prior to the academic session.

Well-Structured Study Pattern

The MBBS course in Bangladesh has a well-structured program pattern utilizing a semester system (six months normally).

  • Preclinical phase: Emphasizes basic disciplines such as Anatomy, Physiology, and Biochemistry.
  • Para-clinical Phase: Covers aspects from pathology and microbiology to pharmacology, including forensic medicine.
  • Clinical Phase: Emphasizes practical training in Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynecology, and Pediatrics.

Career Opportunities After MBBS

After completing MBBS in Bangladesh, Indian students can return to India and appear for FMGE or NExT to practice.

  • Postgraduate Studies: Graduates can also pursue MD or MS in India or abroad.
  • Global Exams: Students may also prepare for global exams like USMLE, PLAB and AMC for international careers.
  • Diverse Roles: Job opportunities include roles in hospitals, clinics, public health, research and telemedicine.
MBBS in Bangladesh Syllabus

Comprehensive medical curriculum

The course contains both theoretical knowledge and clinical practices.

Phase 1 (1.5 Years)

Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry.

Phase 2 (1 Year)

Community Medicine, Forensic Medicine.

Phase 3 (1 Year)

Pharmacology, Pathology, Microbiology.

Phase 4 (1.5 Years) & Internship

Phase 4: Medicine, Surgery, Pediatrics, Gynecology, ENT, Ophthalmology.
Internship (1 Year): Rotations in major clinical departments.

Comparing MBBS in Bangladesh Vs MBBS in India

Side-by-side decision matrix

01

MBBS in India

  • Seat Availability: The seats in India for pursuing MBBS are limited.
  • Fees Structure: Government college: INR 11,000 to INR 7.5 lakhs; Private college: INR 20 lakhs to INR 80 lakhs (complete course).
  • Course Duration: MBBS in India course duration is 5.5 years (4.5 years academics + 1 year Internship).
02

MBBS in Bangladesh

  • Seat Availability: MBBS in Bangladesh seat is not limited and reserved 25% for Indian students.
  • Fees Structure: MBBS in Bangladesh starting fees is 20 lakhs.
  • Course Duration: MBBS in Bangladesh course duration is 6 years (5 + 1 year Internship).
